presets.name: Drowned Tines
presets.desc: Tine piano with the highs and lows cut away, slow tape wobble and a long dark halo. Floating two-chord beds.

presets.name: Half-Speed Keys
presets.desc: Keys printed to tape at 0.85x speed: lower, slower wobble, darker top. Sits with slowed tracks.

presets.name: Hushed Felt Grand
presets.desc: Soft, close felt piano with the top rolled off. Ballads and slow trap-soul.

presets.name: Syrup Tine
presets.desc: Warm, barky tine piano with chorus and a little drive. Neo-soul comping, behind the beat.

presets.name: Dusk Poly Chords
presets.desc: Saw plus pulse plus sub with thick chorus. Chord stabs or held beds.

presets.name: Pump Saw Stab
presets.desc: Wide supersaw stab with a snappy filter, ducking to the beat. House and future-beats chords.

presets.name: Chorus Jangle Clean
presets.desc: Clean single-coil style guitar through soft chorus and a plate. Bedroom-pop jangle.

presets.name: Five-Take Steel Acoustic
presets.desc: Picked steel-string guitar spread wide with ringing open strings. Intimate verse to big chorus.

presets.name: Porch Nylon
presets.desc: Warm nylon pluck with a woody body. Sad-trap loops and Latin ostinatos.

presets.name: Spring Surf Strum
presets.desc: Bright, slightly driven guitar for fast surf punk and bedroom indie.

presets.name: Night Celesta
presets.desc: Glassy celesta, bright but small. Sparse high arpeggios above the vocal.

presets.name: Boogie Keytar
presets.desc: Saw-plus-pulse lead with a snappy filter. Boogie answer phrases.

presets.name: Bubble Reed Call
presets.desc: Breathy sax-like call soaked in ping-pong echo.

presets.name: Velvet Swell Strings
presets.desc: Ensemble saw strings with a slow swell, delayed vibrato and a soft top.

presets.name: Wonky Analog Poly
presets.desc: Slightly out-of-tune, heavily chorused brassy poly that ducks to the beat.

presets.name: Angel Stretch Cloud
presets.desc: Stretched, floating 'ooh-ah' cloud. In cloud rap it is the lead instrument.

presets.name: Voice-Memo Chop
presets.desc: Short pitched 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for house hooks.

presets.name: Long Glide 808
presets.desc: Clean, long sine 808 with a short pitch thump and soft drive.

presets.name: Disco Pulse Bass
presets.desc: Busy plucky bass with a short filter snap. Disco, boogie and house.

presets.name: Night Drive Keys
presets.desc: Low-passed tine keys with tape wobble and a dark room. Slow late-night chords.

presets.name: Velvet Tines
presets.desc: Clean, round electric piano with a gentle chorus. Neo-soul voicings.

presets.name: Submerged Felt
presets.desc: Felt piano heard through a wall: muffled hammers, warm wobble, long tail.

presets.name: Moonlit Upright
presets.desc: Soft upright with a little detune between strings. Honest and close.

presets.name: Perreo Keys
presets.desc: Bright, barky stab keys that sit on a dembow groove. Pump locked to the beat.

presets.name: Glass Room EP
presets.desc: Tine piano with the bell partial pushed forward, wide and glassy.

presets.name: Tape Organ
presets.desc: Soft drawbar organ printed to a worn tape. Sustains forever.

presets.name: Hazy Reed Keys
presets.desc: Reed electric piano with bite on the attack, then a hazy low-passed body.

presets.name: Submerged Choir
presets.desc: Ghost choir under water. Hold one chord and let it breathe.

presets.name: Midnight Wash
presets.desc: Wide detuned wash, low-passed until it is almost a memory.

presets.name: Supersaw Bloom
presets.desc: Nine-voice supersaw chords that duck to the beat. Instant drop.

presets.name: Neon Haze
presets.desc: Moody saw-and-pulse atmosphere for perreo intros and bridges.

presets.name: Floating Dream Pad
presets.desc: Soft floaty pad with a slow filter drift and dotted echoes. Melodies float on it.

presets.name: Cold Glass
presets.desc: Glassy additive shimmer with slow beating partials.

presets.name: Analog Dusk
presets.desc: Two-oscillator analog pad, warm and slightly resonant.

presets.name: Velvet Strings
presets.desc: Ensemble strings from detuned saws. Slow swell, soft top end.

presets.name: Static Bloom
presets.desc: Pitched noise blooming into a tone. Texture under anything.

presets.name: Future Pluck
presets.desc: Detuned saw pluck with a snappy filter, pumping on the quarter note.

presets.name: Dembow Nylon
presets.desc: Nylon-string pluck with a woody body. Arpeggios and tresillo riffs.

presets.name: Night Marimba
presets.desc: Soft-mallet marimba with a night-time reverb. Tropical melodies.

presets.name: Dusty Kalimba
presets.desc: Thumb piano through a dusty tape deck.

presets.name: Vox Chop Pluck
presets.desc: Short synthetic 'ah' chop. Play it like a lead for vocal-chop hooks.

presets.name: Waterlogged Keen
presets.desc: High, soft sine-ish pluck through water. Dotted-eighth echoes for floating hooks.

presets.name: Glint Harp
presets.desc: Bright plucked harp, wide reverb, sparkling echoes.

presets.name: Hyper Saw Lead
presets.desc: Detuned saw lead for drop melodies. Grit and pump already dialled in.

presets.name: Velvet Square
presets.desc: Rounded square lead, soft and vocal. Hooks over a dembow.

presets.name: Hollow Flute
presets.desc: Breathy synthetic flute with delayed vibrato.

presets.name: Siren Vox Lead
presets.desc: Wordless synthetic voice with a singer's vibrato.

presets.name: Dirty Brass Lead
presets.desc: Low, fuzzy synth brass: dirty, nothing bright. Heavy reggaeton riffs.

presets.name: Grit Saw Lead
presets.desc: Driven saw lead with teeth. Cuts through a busy drop.

presets.name: Crystal FM Bell
presets.desc: Two-operator FM bell, glassy attack and a long shimmering tail.

presets.name: Music Box Memory
presets.desc: Tiny music box with a warped tape memory.

presets.name: Celeste Mist
presets.desc: Celeste under water. Pairs with low-passed keys.

presets.name: Gamelan Glass
presets.desc: Inharmonic metal bars that beat against each other.

presets.name: Ooh Ensemble
presets.desc: Six synthetic singers on an 'ooh'. Big, soft background vocals.

presets.name: Ah Chop Stack
presets.desc: Stacked 'ah' chops for call-and-response hooks.

presets.name: Breath Vox
presets.desc: A pitched whisper. Doubles a topline without getting in the way.

presets.name: Formant Swirl
presets.desc: Vowels morphing a-o-e-u while you hold the note.

presets.name: Long 808
presets.desc: Clean, long 808 with a short pitch drop. Glue for every low end.

presets.name: Grit 808
presets.desc: Saturated 808 that reads on phone speakers.

presets.name: Punch 808
presets.desc: Short, punchy 808 for bouncing dembow bass lines.

presets.name: Reese Shadow
presets.desc: Detuned saw reese with a sine underneath. Dark and moving.

presets.name: Degraded Floor Bass
presets.desc: Saw plus sine bass crushed to a 4.4 kHz sample rate. Dark, grainy floor.

presets.name: Round Sub
presets.desc: Pure sustained sub. Sits under keys without clouding them.

presets.name: Dembow Bass
presets.desc: Round plucky bass for tight reggaeton lines.
